title: anartia flavescens
intro: Anartia flavescens, commonly known as the yellow sulphur butterfly flower or yellow passion flower, is a type of flowering plant. The plant is known for its vibrant yellow flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Anartia flavescens include its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, and its therapeutic actions include sedative and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
